description: This source file defines the UserEditor class, a property editor for serializing and deserializing User objects, supporting lookup by ID and UUID, within the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: UserEditor
classes.description: A property editor for User objects, allowing serialization/deserialization and retrieval by ID or UUID.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a User object by its numeric ID using the user service.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a User object by its UUID using the user service.
